messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency SLO breached for /v1/generate (dedicated-us-west pool). Current p99 = 5.2s (SLO 2.0s). Queue depth rising. Paging sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): ack. I'm swapping to triage. Can someone grab warmup & autoscale telemetry?

moria (sre): looking at autoscaler logs now. Observed delayed scale-up handshakes starting 1715559920; desired-capacity requests queued for ~80s due to handshake timeout with warmup workers.

alex (runtime): got it — warmup probes show KV-cache coldloads on newly spawned nodes, warmup agent not completing prefetch within 30s. streaming workers report stalls at token 1->8 for some requests.

sam (oncall): customer impact? Jordan, any support tickets?

jordan (customer-ops): two customers reported degraded streaming (partial tokens, long tails). One enterprise (acct: AcmeCorp) hit user-visible ~10s delays on chat. They're on a dedicated pool in us-west. Escalated to CSM.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation ideas: 1) pause low-priority background jobs hitting the same pool, 2) increase reserved hotshot slots, 3) force immediate additional nodes with bypass-warmup flag. Opinions?

alex (runtime): we can force scale via internal CLI: `redwood scale-pool --pool dedicated-us-west --count +4 --bypass-warmup true` — but bypass will increase cold-KV misses and may spike cpu on inference hosts. Recommend +2 first and enable aggressive prefix-caching for the route.

moria (sre): I'm throttling low-priority batch routes to 10% of normal concurrency (`route-quota set batch-* 0.1`) to free slots. Applying now.

sam (oncall): apply alex's +2 now, moria keep throttling. I'll notify customers.

deploy-bot: executed: `redwood scale-pool --pool dedicated-us-west --count +2 --bypass-warmup true` — request accepted, provisioning 2 nodes (ETA 45s).

alex (runtime): provisioning logs: new nodes registered at 1715559960, handshake succeeded at 1715559964 but warmup_agent finished prefetch for common prefixes only after ~22s. Streaming clients still showing intermittent stalls while KV warms up.

sam (oncall): switching routing policy to favor warmed nodes: `route-priority set /v1/generate hotshot-first` — doing now.

moria (sre): routing change applied. Observing p95 drop from 1.9s -> 1.4s in the next minute; p99 still at ~3.8s. Queue depth decreased by 40%.

alex (runtime): Started on a short-term fallback: enable smaller model family for streaming route as policy fallback to reduce warmup cost. `model-fallback add /v1/generate model-small-v2` — when larger model slow, small-v2 serves streaming with lower tail.

sam (oncall): add fallback but keep canary: only 20% of traffic.

jordan (customer-ops): AcmeCorp says degradation is improving but they still see token gaps in long responses. Ticket updated, CSM notified.

moria (sre): Warmup metrics: KV cache hit rate on new nodes improved from 4% -> 45% over 3m after the prefetched prefixes. Suggest increasing warmup prefetch set for future (include heavy prefixes seen in production).

sam (oncall): root cause hypothesis: simultaneous warmup of multiple nodes for a hot dedicated pool during a burst; autoscaler handshake delays exacerbated queueing while warmup was inefficient (cold KV causes streaming stalls). Also backlog spike triggered more scale requests than pool could stabilize quickly.

alex (runtime): mitigation summary applied: throttled background routes, forced +2 nodes with bypass, routing warm nodes first, added 20% fallback to model-small-v2, and we adjusted route quotas. Observed 80% reduction in queue depth and p99 trending to 1.8s after 6 minutes.

moria (sre): created follow-up tasks: 1) improve warmup prefetch list (include top-100 prefixes for route), 2) reduce handshake timeout window to avoid queued scale-ups, 3) autoscaler telemetry alert for queued handshake >30s.

sam (oncall): paging: escalate to eng-runtime if p99 >2.5s in next 15m. For now, we're handing off to moria for post-mortem. I'll update incident channel and customer-facing note.

jordan (customer-ops): sending AcmeCorp status update: "We're actively mitigating; some improvements seen; we'll follow up with timeline and root cause post-mortem."

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation checklist updated by sam (oncall). Incident moved to live-mitigation -> follow-up.

alex (runtime): quick snippet for postmortem notes: ```
- Observed: burst requests -> multiple concurrent scale-up requests
- Failure point: autoscaler handshake queueing + warmup prefetch insufficient
- Customer impact: p99 spikes 3-10s for streaming, partial token stalls
- Short-term fixes: manual scale + routing change + model fallback
- Long-term actions: prefetch tuning, handshake timeout reduction, autoscaler backoff tuning
```

moria (sre): logging runbook steps in ops playbook. assigning tickets: WARMUP-457 (prefetch list), AUTOSCALE-682 (handshake timeout), ROUTING-114 (hotshot priority).

sam (oncall): handoff complete. I'll leave channel open for further telemetry. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
